title: Reverse a String
description: Write a function to reverse a given string without using built-in reverse methods.
instructions: Create a method that takes a string as input and returns the reversed string. Example: 'hello' -> 'olleh'

title: Check Palindrome
description: Write a function to check if a given string is a palindrome.
instructions: A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Return true if palindrome, false otherwise. Ignore case.

title: Fibonacci Number
description: Write a function to return the nth Fibonacci number.
instructions: The Fibonacci sequence: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13... Return the nth number (0-indexed).

title: Find Factorial
description: Write a function to calculate the factorial of a number.
instructions: Factorial of n (n!) = n * (n-1) * (n-2) * ... * 1. Return the factorial of the given number.

title: Prime Number Check
description: Write a function to check if a number is prime.
instructions: A prime number is only divisible by 1 and itself. Return true if prime, false otherwise.

title: Find Second Largest
description: Write a function to find the second largest element in an array.
instructions: Given an array of integers, find and return the second largest element. Assume array has at least 2 elements.

title: Remove Duplicates
description: Write a function to remove duplicate elements from an array.
instructions: Given an array, return a new array with duplicates removed while maintaining original order.

title: Two Sum Problem
description: Write a function that finds two numbers in an array that add up to a target sum.
instructions: Return the indices of the two numbers. Assume exactly one solution exists.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Write a function to reverse a singly linked list.
instructions: Given the head of a linked list, reverse the list and return the new head.

title: Binary Search
description: Implement binary search algorithm to find an element in a sorted array.
instructions: Return the index of the target element, or -1 if not found.
